gen-audiowide-gf-anek-bangla: Audiowide draws every curve with no thickening at all, like tiles set in a grid. Anek Bangla is a plain sans with wide, barely curled s shapes and a short climb to its ascenders, so it feels friendly beside it.
gen-audiowide-gf-anek-devanagari: Thin-looking, futuristic letters with no lighter joins: that's Audiowide, tall in its lowercase and tile-like. Anek Devanagari, a sans-serif, does the opposite job, opening its letter mouths over a tall middle zone.
gen-audiowide-gf-anek-gujarati: Audiowide has a steady, marker-like line that makes each glyph feel like a tile in a futuristic grid. Anek Gujarati, a sans with lowercase nearly rivaling its capitals and a gaping c, gives that grid a friendly counterweight.
gen-audiowide-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Audiowide forms each glyph from a ribbon of constant width, with a futuristic, tile-like look. Its strength is tech-flavored display character, while Anek Gurmukhi, a sans-serif, does its best work with big open counters and generous round curves.
gen-audiowide-gf-anek-kannada: Audiowide looks cut out by a fixed-width router bit, with tall lowercase and wide gaps between its tile-like glyphs. Anek Kannada, a sans, counters with a high x-height like squared-off woodblock type and terminals that stop far from the stem.
gen-audiowide-gf-anek-latin: Anek Latin holds its tall lowercase nearly up to the capitals, with letters that stay open rather than curling shut. Audiowide, a pen-like futuristic display face of constant weight, adds its tile-like tech edge above that plain sans.
gen-audiowide-gf-anek-malayalam: Anek Malayalam reads clean and contemporary, with almost no gap between x-height and caps and curve tips that never touch. Audiowide, with its pipe-cleaner futuristic letterforms, earns its keep big and short.
gen-audiowide-gf-anek-odia: Audiowide gives futuristic, tile-like letters whose curves never thin out, with lowercase that runs tall against its capitals. Anek Odia, a sans-serif with unlatched, hook-like rounds, would read cleanly and contemporary over a long passage.
gen-audiowide-gf-anek-tamil: Futuristic, tech-minded Audiowide has no contrast between its stems and joins, and its glyphs sit like tiles. And if that heading shrank small, Anek Tamil, a sans with big round bowls and half-unwrapped c and s shapes, would start to outshine it.
gen-audiowide-gf-anek-telugu: Futuristic Audiowide sets horizontal bars exactly as heavy as its upright stems, like tiles with wide grout lines. Anek Telugu, a sans-serif, rounds that curve out like unlatched hooks, brings a friendly, approachable ease.
